title: Chapter 153
text:
Han Xiao watched with interest. Laughing Blade? I don't remember him. He probably didn't make a name for himself in Galaxy. Mad Blade was going to be a god-level player in the future, but right now, he was lowering his head in front of Laughing Blade. This scene made him feel a sense of déjà vu, and it reminded him of his own past. Back then, there was a time when the leveling business was declining, and he could only find a way to earn some money. He joined a small studio to earn some money for them, but that studio always delayed and deducted his salary. Every time he asked, they would reject him.

The boss of the studio took advantage of his' big business'. When Han Xiao quarreled with the studio for the ninth time, the boss acted like a big wolf in front of him. He told Han Xiao to do what he wanted, but if he didn't, he could scram. Then, he chased after him until his level dropped to zero.

What else could Han Xiao do? He was also in despair. He could only use his main account to let the boss know why the flowers were so red and why he was so flirtatious. He directly killed the studio until it was on the brink of bankruptcy for a few consecutive weeks, earning a reasonable amount of compensation for mental damage. Blackmail in the game was not illegal.

Sigh, the happy times are gone forever. Han Xiao took a puff of his cigarette. He felt a sense of melancholy, as if he had been through a vast ocean and could not find water.

Mad Blade could only agree to Laughing Blade's request. He was now LV 11, which was above the average level of the players. Other than the repair and enhancement skills of the Mechanic class, he only knew basic shooting and close combat skills.

Han Xiao knew Mad Blade's strength very well. His eyes flashed, and he called Mad Blade, "Come here."

Mad Blade was a little confused. He moved closer, and Han Xiao took off a thermo-electric incisor glove and secretly passed it to him.

Looking at the attributes of the glove, Mad Blade's breathing stopped. He was shocked and surprised.

"I'm lending it to you. You have to return it." Han Xiao dispelled Mad Blade's unrealistic illusion.

Mad Blade was still very touched. He did not choose the wrong person. He actually received such benefits! Was he afraid that I would lose and embarrass him?

After putting on the gloves, Mad Blade and Furious Sword gained confidence. They stood fifteen meters away from Laughing Blade and Sword, ready to make a move.

The nearby players all gathered around to watch the show, mainly because they were curious about Mad Blade's Furious Sword. They wanted to see the difference between a professional player who had made the headlines and an ordinary player.

"Even if it's a professional player, it should be the same in the early stages."

"He only has a few basic skills. I don't think he can show off his skills."

"I think those who have an advantage in the early stages should be those who have trained in combat in real life or served as soldiers. After all, the control is so realistic."

The surrounding players discussed in low voices.

With a low roar, Dao Jianxiao took the lead and charged forward. With every step he took, the sand on the ground would crawl up his calves like snakes, forming an armor of sand that covered his body.

His pistol can only fire five shots at most. My Esper ability can block them. As long as I can close the distance, he's dead meat! Dao Jianxiao thought to himself.

Players were all newbies. Their skill level was limited to the use and understanding of skills. Dao Jianxiao's choice was correct. However, Mad Blade's reaction surprised Dao Jianxiao. He did not retreat and kite him with his pistol. Instead, he charged forward.

The two of them quickly clashed. Dao Jianxiao did not have time to think. His fist, which was wrapped in sand, slammed down. Mad Blade's black-gloved palm met with it.

Is this glove a piece of equipment?

Just as Dao Jianxiao had this thought, he suddenly felt a burning pain. He was shocked to find that his HP had dropped to zero.

His vision turned black, and he died …

From start to end, this PK only lasted three seconds!

Only Mad Blade's Furious Sword was left in the arena. The wind blew at his sleeves. He was expressionless, looking very much like a lonely expert.

The surrounding players were dumbfounded. They could not react in time.

"This … this is an instant kill?"

"That's too fast!"

"That's too strong. No wonder he can be on Galaxy Times!"

"Could it be that the hidden quest gave him such a huge lead?"

Both of them were newbies. Logically speaking, their combat strength should be about the same. It would take at least four or five shots to kill them. Furthermore, Dao Jianxiao's Esper Ability was clearly to increase his defense. Some players recalled Dao Jianxiao's performance when facing the beast attack. He could hold on even when surrounded by two Gray Devil Wolves. However, he actually died after exchanging blows with Mad Blade?

What kind of attack power was that?

Everyone stared at Frenzied Sword's glove with envy.

"That's a piece of high-level equipment!"

"A Mechanic can make something like that? I thought they could only make guns! "

"I want one too …"

Not long after, the revived Dao Jianxiao ran over. His expression was ugly as he said unhappily, "We agreed to have a friendly spar. You … why did you …"

He originally wanted to ask why he killed him, but he felt that it would be too embarrassing and did not say it out loud.

After defeating his old rival, Mad Blade's Furious Sword felt proud. He chuckled and said, "Sorry, I didn't know you were so fragile."

His words made Dao Jianxiao so angry that his chest tightened.

You're blaming me for being fragile when you die?

"What a loss." Dying once and losing a lot of EXP made Dao Jianxiao's heart ache. He originally thought that the PK would end there, but he did not expect to be killed instantly. Furthermore, he was forced to the point where he could not blame Mad Blade's Furious Sword.

After the crowd dispersed, Mad Blade's Furious Sword obediently returned the glove to Han Xiao. He hesitated and asked, "Han … Black Phantom, are you selling this glove?"

Han Xiao glanced at him, opened the shop list, and added 'Thermo-Electric Incisor Gloves'. It was priced at 80,000 and had a favorability of 15 points. This pair of gloves was a spoil of war he had obtained from Rose Militant. After learning the prerequisites, he had reverse-engineered the blueprint of the Thermo-Electric Incisor Gloves. After spending some EXP, he could already make his own gloves.

Mad Blade's Furious Sword was suddenly motivated. He clenched his fists excitedly. This type of close combat mechanical equipment was his favorite. "I can't afford it now, but I'll be able to buy it sooner or later!"

At this time, Dao Jianxiao suddenly came over. He looked at Han Xiao with burning eyes and said, "Black Phantom, I heard that you are an enemy of the Germinal Organization. I want to join you."

During this period of time, there were all kinds of guesses about triggering Black Phantom's hidden quest on the forums. They believed that as long as one showed an attitude of being an enemy of the Germinal Organization, there would be a chance of triggering Black Phantom's hidden quest. Many players guessed the lines, but Han Xiao had already heard them many times in the short time he had been in Green Valley Town. He rejected all of them. This made the players finally have a reliable guess. Black Phantom's hidden quest depended entirely on probability. Being weak was the truth. Dao Jianxiao was just trying his luck.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and said, "Oh … you seem to be quite good."

"There's a way!" Dao Jianxiao was pleasantly surprised.

Mad Blade's Furious Sword's heart skipped a beat. He became nervous and felt an inexplicable sense of sourness.

"But you seem to be lacking a little." Han Xiao suddenly changed the topic. He waved his hand and rejected Dao Jianxiao's offer.

Dao Jianxiao did not manage to catch his breath. He was speechless for a long time. His expression was angry, and he was jealous of Mad Blade's Furious Sword. He cursed in his heart, This guy is really lucky.

Mad Blade's Furious Sword heaved a sigh of relief and became happy again.

Han Xiao saw Mad Blade's reaction and wanted to laugh. He was like a man who had almost been cuckolded … Pfft, what kind of bullsh * t description is that? What would that make me? Han Xiao hurriedly shook off this bullsh * t thought.

The EXP on the interface had accumulated quite a lot. The next day, all the interested players in Green Valley Town would be done with their class change. Han Xiao prepared to leave the next day.

While he was collecting EXP, someone recorded the battle between Mad Blade's Furious Sword and Dao Jianxiao and posted it on the forums.

…

Luzman was a player born in Big Horn Village. He won the closed beta opportunity through lottery. He had been saving money and did not change his class. He wanted the strongest class.

Until the open beta, when he saw Black Phantom's performance, he was immediately attracted and wanted to change his class to the Mechanic class. Other players used missions to increase Black Phantom's favorability, but Luzman could not hold back and spent five points to increase his favorability. Among the five basic knowledges that Black Phantom taught him, he learned [Basic Weapon Study], which was the one with the most suitable name.

However, Luzman soon realized that the Mechanic class was not as strong as what Black Phantom showed. After losing in PK, he felt that he was cheated. This class was as weak as a dog! However, he did not want to give up his closed beta account. He asked the customer service if he could change his class. The result was, of course, no. This made him furious.

What a waste of his luck to get the closed beta opportunity! His account was ruined!

Luzman was so angry that he wanted to vent his anger on the forums. He posted everywhere. No matter what the topic was, he wanted to copy the comments that he made about the Mechanic class and tell all the players that the Mechanic class was trash!

The players argued in his replies, and Luzman was satisfied. This was his original intention. He wanted to spread the word, and he liked the feeling of being valued.
